label: SugarCube 2 (Twine) - web build, Playwright QA, web/itch/desktop packaging
description: Builds the game as a SugarCube 2 Twine story. Copies the Forge runtime (engine/runtime) and the loop modules (engine/modules) into forge/engine/, adds the build, QA, optimize and packaging settings to forge.yaml, and installs Playwright + Chromium and the SugarCube 2 story format into the project.

setup.why: automated playthroughs, performance QA and WebP encoding (npm package)
the headless Chromium browser Playwright drives
the SugarCube 2 story format (latest release from github.com/tmedwards/sugarcube-2) into vendor/sugarcube-2/
